literal_meaning: ধরে আঁকড়ে ধরে বেঁধে ফেলা (holding and binding)
figurative_meaning_en: Tormenting or forcing someone against their will
example_sentences_in_bangla: তাকে ধরে বেঁধে রাজি করানো হলো।
পরিবারের লোকেরা ধরে বেঁধে বিয়ের জন্য চাপ দিল।
example_sentences_in_english: They forced him against his will to agree.
The family pressured her into marriage through constant harassment.
note: This idiom reflects traditional methods of persuasion in Bengali society, often in rural or familial contexts.
